issues.description: Renaming audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a breaking API change
issues.detail: The changelog notes this as a rename, but FastAPIWebsocketParams is a public Pydantic model. Existing users passing audio_packet_bytes=... will get a validation error on upgrade with no deprecation path. Consider adding a deprecated alias that forwards to the new field for at least one release cycle.

issues.description: Pipeline sample rate defaults to 0 if setup() is never called
issues.detail: self._sample_rate = 0 in __init__ and only gets set in setup(). If deserialize() runs before setup() (e.g., early binary frames from Vonage on connect), the resampler will be called with target rate 0, producing undefined behavior or errors. Guard against this or initialize lazily on first StartFrame.

issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size validation missing; odd values will misalign PCM samples
issues.detail: No validator ensures packet_bytes is a positive multiple of the sample width (e.g., 2 bytes for PCM16) and channel count. A user passing 641 or a negative value would chunk audio mid-sample or loop forever. Add a Pydantic validator or runtime check rejecting non-positive or misaligned sizes.

issues.description: Packetization bypasses non-audio payloads when buffer is non-empty
issues.detail: When fixed_audio_packet_size is set and payload is bytes, the code buffers and returns without ever falling through. If the serializer emits a JSON string interleaved with audio, the string path is fine, but trailing bytes in the buffer at end-of-stream are silently dropped. Consider flushing remainder on EndFrame/CancelFrame, not just InterruptionFrame.

issues.description: No real-time pacing despite PR description claiming it
issues.detail: The PR description says enhancements add 'real-time pacing,' but the diff only adds size-based packetization. The existing _send_interval/_next_send_time logic isn't tied to fixed_audio_packet_size. Either clarify the changelog or wire pacing to packet duration so endpoints requiring strict timing actually get it.

issues.description: DTMF fallback path references undocumented message shape
issues.detail: message.get('dtmf', {}).get('digit') is a defensive fallback not described in Vonage docs linked in the module. Either cite the source for the alternate shape or remove the speculative branch to avoid masking real protocol drift behind silent acceptance.

review.summary: The Vonage serializer is straightforward and well-scoped, but has a latent zero-sample-rate bug if deserialize runs before setup. The FastAPI transport changes are useful but introduce a breaking rename without a deprecation alias, lack validation on packet size alignment, and don't actually implement the real-time pacing claimed in the PR description. Packet buffer flushing is also only handled for InterruptionFrame, not end-of-stream.
